profile: gradient: The first derivative of a function, generalized to multiple inputs. At a point, the derivative of a single-input function, or the gradient of a multi-input function, gives precisely the slope information at that point. Fundamental first-order optimization algorithms leverage the first derivative or gradient of a function.
